    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    bg = freq.most_common(1)[0][0]

    # preference for components having a line-like silhouette.

        ys = [r for r, c in cells]

        lineish = max(height, width) / max(1, min(height, width))

    mc = col_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]

            if color == bg or color == marker or (r, c) in seen:

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter, deque

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    # Long L-shaped color acts as a pointer; identify it by its long straight run.
    def longest_run(color):
        best = 0
        for r in range(h):
            n = 0
            for c in range(w):
                n = n + 1 if grid[r][c] == color else 0
                best = max(best, n)
        for c in range(w):
            n = 0
            for r in range(h):
                n = n + 1 if grid[r][c] == color else 0
                best = max(best, n)
        return best

    marker = max((v for v in set(v for row in grid for v in row) if v != bg),
                 key=longest_run)
    marked = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker}

    # Connected objects, excluding background and pointer.
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color in (bg, marker) or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if (0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen
                            and grid[yy][xx] == color):
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        q.append((yy,xx))
            objects.append(cells)

    if not objects:
        return grid

    # Pick the object nearest the pointer, favoring compact block-like objects.
    def rank(cells):
        d = min(abs(r-y) + abs(c-x) for r,c in cells for y,x in marked)
        rs = [r for r,c in cells]
        cs = [c for r,c in cells]
        area = (max(rs)-min(rs)+1) * (max(cs)-min(cs)+1)
        compact = len(cells) / area
        return (d, -compact, -len(cells))

    target = min(objects, key=rank)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in target:
        out[r][c] = marker
    return out

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter, deque

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    freq = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = freq.most_common(1)[0][0]

    def max_run(v):
        best = 0
        for r in range(h):
            n = 0
            for c in range(w):
                n = n + 1 if grid[r][c] == v else 0
                best = max(best, n)
        for c in range(w):
            n = 0
            for r in range(h):
                n = n + 1 if grid[r][c] == v else 0
                best = max(best, n)
        return best

    marker = max((v for v in freq if v != bg), key=max_run)
    marks = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]

    # Components of the remaining colors.
    seen, comps = set(), []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color in (bg, marker) or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r,c)])
            seen.add((r,c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y,x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        q.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append((color,cells))

    # The marker's long upright stroke and crossbar make an L. Select the
    # object immediately beyond the upright stroke, on the crossbar side.
    rc = Counter(r for r,c in marks)
    cc = Counter(c for r,c in marks)
    long_r = max(rc.values())
    long_c = max(cc.values())
    if long_c >= long_r:
        stem_c = cc.most_common(1)[0][0]
        stem_rows = [r for r,c in marks if c == stem_c]
        elbow_r = max(stem_rows) if len(stem_rows) > 1 else stem_rows[0]
        # horizontal arm direction from elbow
        arm = [c for r,c in marks if r == elbow_r and c != stem_c]
        direction = 1 if arm and max(arm) > stem_c else -1
    else:
        stem_r = rc.most_common(1)[0][0]
        stem_cols = [c for r,c in marks if r == stem_r]
        elbow_c = max(stem_cols) if len(stem_cols) > 1 else stem_cols[0]
        arm = [r for r,c in marks if c == elbow_c and r != stem_r]
        direction = 1 if arm and max(arm) > stem_r else -1

    def rank(obj):
        color,cells = obj
        if long_c >= long_r:
            # Favor components to the right/left of the vertical stem.
            side = min((c-stem_c)*direction for r,c in cells)
            dist = min(abs(r-elbow_r)+abs(c-stem_c) for r,c in cells)
        else:
            side = min((r-stem_r)*direction for r,c in cells)
            dist = min(abs(r-stem_r)+abs(c-elbow_c) for r,c in cells)
        return (side < 0, abs(side), dist, -len(cells))

    if not comps:
        return grid
    target = min(comps, key=rank)[1]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in target:
        out[r][c] = marker
    return out
